correctness.rationale: The simultaneous shift and all stated consequences hold under the two endpoint coprimality hypotheses, without any coprimality assumption on an intermediate pair. An independent algebraic check uses (1-z^a)P_{a,b}(z) = sum_{i=0}^{a-1}z^i - sum_{i=0}^{a-1}z^{ib}, where P is the gap polynomial. Subtract the corresponding identity at (a+m,b+m) in the polynomial ring modulo z^m-1. The increment profile f satisfies f(t)-f(t-a)=1-e*1_{e|t}; exchanging a,b yields f(t)-f(t-b)=1-d*1_{d|t}. The proposed sawtooths satisfy both cyclic differences, since a is -k modulo e and b is k modulo d. The two differences determine f up to a constant because gcd(a,b)=1; the difference of the Sylvester genera fixes its mean to a+(k+m-2)/2. CRT yields the asserted product-uniform multiplicities, range and variance, and t=0 counts exactly the quotient gaps. The source's Fourier recurrence is understood as a change of -1, rather than a decrease by -1. The frozen verifier was inspected, not executed.
